water-cheer: You practiced water pouring from start to finish!
water-s1: Gather a pitcher and two cups.
water-s2: Fill the pitcher just a little.
water-s5: Wipe any drips. Wiping makes you a pouring pro.
beans-cheer: You practiced bean pouring from start to finish!
beans-s1: Gather a pitcher and two cups for bean pouring.
beans-s2: Fill one cup with a few dry beans.
beans-s3: Beans are great for first-time pourers. Pour slowly and listen to the sound they make.
beans-s4: Pour the beans back the other way.
beans-s4-after: You listened and poured with care.
beans-s5: Scoop up any beans that spilled. Cleanup is part of the work.
